cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen renders with header, captions, key legend and prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator is signed on and selects Transaction View (transaction ORTV) from the main menu.
cases.steps:
1. From the main menu, start Transaction View (transaction ORTV).
2. Look at the freshly opened screen.
cases.expected: The screen title 『ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM』 shows on the top line with the current date and time; the captions Tran:, Pgm:, Tran ID :, Card Num:, Type, Amount, Merchant:, Desc: are shown; the detail fields are empty; the message line shows 「Enter a transaction id and press ENTER.」; the bottom key legend shows 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」.
cases.remark: §2.1 MTRANVA · MTRANV.bms · 1000-SEND-INITIAL / 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · WS-M-PROMPT

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Transaction detail fields render after a successful lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Look at the detail area.
cases.expected: The detail area shows Card Num = 4000000000000001, Type = 01, Amount = 1,234.56, Merchant = ACME RETAIL STORE, Desc = Grocery purchase downtown; the message line shows 「Transaction details displayed.」.
cases.remark: §2.1 · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL · TRAN-REC (RTRAN) · WS-M-TRAN-FOUND · F-STD row 1

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the entry field has the cursor and detail fields are blank
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has just started Transaction View (transaction ORTV).
cases.steps:
1. Observe where the cursor sits on the fresh screen.
2. Observe the detail fields and the header.
cases.expected: The cursor sits in the Tran ID entry field (it has initial focus); the Card Num, Type, Amount, Merchant and Desc fields are empty; the header date and time carry the current values (e.g. 2026-09-28 / 14:30:00); the prompt 「Enter a transaction id and press ENTER.」 is shown.
cases.remark: §2 item-states · TRANID ATTRB IC · 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE -1 TO cursor) · 8500-GET-DATE-TIME (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME)

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Only Tran ID is enterable; every detail field is display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open, and separately a record has been displayed for TXN0000000000001.
cases.steps:
1. On the entry prompt, try to type into Card Num, Type, Amount, Merchant, Desc.
2. Type into Tran ID.
3. After a record is shown, check the same fields again.
cases.expected: Only the Tran ID field accepts input; Card Num, Type, Amount, Merchant and Desc are protected (cannot be typed into) both before and after a record is shown; the Tran ID field remains the only unprotected field.
cases.remark: MTRANV.bms: TRANID ATTRB=(UNPROT,IC,FSET); all detail fields ATTRB=ASKIP · §2 item-states table

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Header date and time are formatted year-month-day and hour:minute:second
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps: 1. Read the Date and Time values in the top header.
cases.expected: The Date shows the current date as year-month-day separated by hyphens (e.g. 2026-09-28) in a 10-character field; the Time shows the current time as hour:minute:second separated by colons (e.g. 14:30:00) in an 8-character field.
cases.remark: 8500-GET-DATE-TIME · EXEC CICS FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') YYYYMMDD / TIME TIMESEP(':') · WHEAD WS-HDR-DATE/WS-HDR-TIME

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Transaction type shows the raw two-character code, not a description
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000003.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Type field.
cases.expected: The Type field shows the two-character code 03 exactly as stored on the record; no type-name lookup is done, so the words CASH ADVANCE do not appear.
cases.remark: 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL: TR-TYPE-CD X(2) → TRTYPE (LEN=2); no TTYPFILE read · F-STD row 3

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Description longer than 50 characters is truncated to 50 on display
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000004 (its stored description is exactly 100 characters).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Desc field.
cases.expected: The Desc field shows only the first 50 characters of the stored 100-character description; the remaining characters are not shown (the display field is 50 columns wide).
cases.remark: TR-DESC X(100) → TRDESC (LEN=50) truncation · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL · F-STD row 4

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Positive amount is comma-edited on display
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 (stored amount 1234.56).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Amount field.
cases.expected: The Amount field shows 1,234.56 with a thousands comma and two decimal places, right-justified in the 15-character field.
cases.remark: TR-AMT S9(9)V99 → WS-ED-AMT (-,---,---,--9.99) → WS-ED-AMT(2:15) → TRAMT · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL · F-STD row 1

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Zero amount displays as 0.00
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000003 (stored amount 0.00).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Amount field.
cases.expected: The Amount field shows 0.00; the suppressed high-order positions are blank and no comma is shown for the zero value.
cases.remark: TR-AMT = 0 → WS-ED-AMT (-,---,---,--9.99) zero-suppress · F-STD row 3

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Maximum amount 999,999,999.99 fits the 15-character field
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000004 (stored amount 999999999.99, the largest the field holds).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Amount field.
cases.expected: The Amount field shows 999,999,999.99 in full with thousands commas and two decimals, exactly filling the 15-character field with no truncation.
cases.remark: TR-AMT max S9(9)V99 = 999999999.99 → 15-char edited value → TRAMT (LEN=15) · F-STD row 4

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Negative (credit) amount keeps its minus sign on display
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000002 (a payment with stored amount -500.00).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the Amount field.
cases.expected: The Amount field shows -500.00 with the floating minus sign; dropping the always-blank leading pad byte keeps the sign inside the 15-character field.
cases.remark: TR-AMT negative → WS-ED-AMT floating '-' → WS-ED-AMT(2:15) drops blank pad byte, sign preserved · F-STD row 2

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open (with or without a record shown).
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3.
cases.expected: Control is handed to the main menu (OCMENU); the Transaction View screen closes and the main menu is displayed.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU · EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) · §1.2 PF3=Back

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the screen and re-shows the entry prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. A record has been displayed for TXN0000000000001.
cases.steps:
1. With the detail fields populated, press PF4.
2. Look at the screen.
cases.expected: The screen is wiped clean: Tran ID and all detail fields are empty, the cursor returns to the Tran ID field, and the message line shows 「Enter a transaction id and press ENTER.」 again.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES, ERASE) · §1.2 PF4=Clear

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: First entry shows the prompt; the next keypress is processed
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has not yet entered Transaction View in this session.
cases.steps:
1. Start Transaction View (transaction ORTV) for the first time.
2. Confirm the empty prompt screen appears.
3. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 and press ENTER.
cases.expected: On the first entry the empty prompt screen is shown (not a record); on the following ENTER the keyed transaction is read and its details are shown — the pseudo-conversational screen keeps its place between keypresses.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: EIBCALEN=0 / CA-FIRST-ENTER (CA-PGM-CONTEXT=0) → 1000-SEND-INITIAL; else 2000-PROCESS-INPUT · RETURN TRANSID(ORTV)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Re-query: a second Tran ID refreshes the detail area
cases.precondition: F-STD. A record has been displayed for TXN0000000000001.
cases.steps:
1. Overtype Tran ID with TXN0000000000002.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the detail area.
cases.data: First Tran ID = TXN0000000000001, then Tran ID = TXN0000000000002
cases.expected: The screen stays on Transaction View and the detail area is replaced with the second transaction: Card Num = 4000000000000002, Type = 02, Amount = -500.00, Merchant = ONLINE PAYMENT CENTER; the message line shows 「Transaction details displayed.」.
cases.remark: 2100-READ-AND-SHOW re-read on ENTER; screen stays on MTRANVA · F-STD rows 1→2

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Main flow: look up an existing transaction and view its details
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Review the returned detail fields and the message line.
cases.expected: The transaction is read by its key and its full detail is shown — Card Num = 4000000000000001, Type = 01, Amount = 1,234.56, Merchant = ACME RETAIL STORE, Desc = Grocery purchase downtown — and the message line shows 「Transaction details displayed.」. No file row is changed.
cases.remark: §1.2 lookup+view · 2100-READ-AND-SHOW → 3000-READ-TRAN (EXEC CICS READ FILE(TRANFILE) key TR-ID) → 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL · WS-M-TRAN-FOUND

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Content variant: a payment (type 02) with a credit amount displays correctly
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000002.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Review the detail fields.
cases.expected: The payment transaction is shown: Type = 02, Amount = -500.00 (credit), Merchant = ONLINE PAYMENT CENTER, Card Num = 4000000000000002; the message line shows 「Transaction details displayed.」. The display path is the same for every type code (no per-type branching in the program).
cases.remark: single display path for all TR-TYPE-CD values; variant chosen for negative amount + type 02 · F-STD row 2

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Read-only: repeating the same lookup returns identical data and changes nothing
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 and press ENTER.
2. Press PF4 to clear.
3. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 again and press ENTER.
4. Compare the two results and the transaction file afterwards.
cases.expected: Both lookups show the identical detail (Amount = 1,234.56, Merchant = ACME RETAIL STORE, etc.); the transaction file is unchanged — no row is created, updated or deleted (the screen only reads).
cases.remark: §5 read-only (no WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE) · EXEC CICS READ only · idempotent

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank Tran ID is rejected as required
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Tran ID empty (or type only spaces).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No lookup is done; the message line shows 「Transaction id is required.」 and the cursor returns to the Tran ID field for re-entry.
cases.remark: 2100-READ-AND-SHOW: IF TRANIDI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → WS-M-ID-REQUIRED (no EI/EF codes in ORION-CCMS)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Unknown Tran ID returns a not-found message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = TXN0000000009999 (no such transaction on file).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The read finds no record; the detail fields stay empty and the message line shows 「Transaction not found - check the id.」.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-TRAN resp NOTFND → REC-NOT-FOUND → 2100 WHEN OTHER → WS-M-TRAN-NOTFND (no EI/EF codes)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Unsupported function key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open.
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key, for example PF1.
cases.data: Key pressed = PF1 (not ENTER / PF3 / PF4)
cases.expected: No lookup or navigation happens; the screen is refreshed and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN OTHER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL + WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG) · the only message in design §3 · no EI/EF codes

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Full 16-character Tran ID (field maximum) is accepted and matched
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter the full 16-character key Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 (the entry field holds at most 16 characters).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Tran ID = TXN0000000000001 (16 characters, field maximum)
cases.expected: The 16-character key is accepted (the field allows no 17th character) and the matching transaction is shown with 「Transaction details displayed.」.
cases.remark: MTRANV.bms TRANID LENGTH=16; TR-ID X(16) · boundary max · F-STD row 1

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Single-character Tran ID (minimum non-blank) is space-padded and not matched
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction View screen is open at the entry prompt.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Tran ID = 1 (a single character).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Tran ID = 1 (1 character; padded to 16 as '1' + 15 spaces)
cases.expected: The one-character entry passes the required-field check, is padded to the 16-character key, and — because no record has that padded key — the message line shows 「Transaction not found - check the id.」.
cases.remark: 2100: TRANIDI not blank → INSPECT REPLACING LOW-VALUE BY SPACE → 16-char key → NOTFND · boundary min non-blank
